info.name: Fund Transfer Assessment
info.description: Postman collection aligned with the current Spring Boot fund transfer API contract, including idempotency replay, validation failures, duplicate data conflicts, and missing-account scenarios.

item.name: Customer Accounts
item.description: Endpoints for creating funded customer accounts and checking balances. POST requests require Idempotency-Key and return the shared API response envelope.

request.description: Creates a funded customer account. Expected result: 201 Created.

response.name: 201 Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Customer account created and funded successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "customerId": "CUST-001",
    "customerName": "Alice",
    "accountNumber": "ACC001",
    "transactionReference": "TXN-001",
    "transactionAmount": 5000.00,
    "currentBalance": 5000.00,
    "createdAt": "2026-08-04T02:30:00"
  },
  "errors": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-04T02:30:00+03:00",
  "path": "/api/v1/customer-accounts",
  "errorCode": null
}

request.description: Replays the exact same request with the same Idempotency-Key. Expected result: 200 OK with the original payload.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body:

item.name: Reuse Key With Different Customer Payload

request.description: Reuses an Idempotency-Key with a different normalized request body. Expected result: 409 Conflict and IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT.

response.name: 409 Conflict
response.body:
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Idempotency key has already been used with a different request payload",
  "errors": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-04T02:32:00+03:00",
  "path": "/api/v1/customer-accounts",
  "errorCode": "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT",
  "correlationId": "corr-20260804-0001"
}

request.description: Omits the required Idempotency-Key header. Expected result: 400 Bad Request and MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.
Sends a funding amount with more than 2 decimal places. Expected result: 400 Bad Request and VALIDATION_ERROR.

response.name: 400 Validation Error

request.description: Attempts to create a second customer with an existing account number. Expected result: 409 Conflict and DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT.
Attempts to reuse an existing funding transaction reference. Expected result: 409 Conflict and DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION_REFERENCE.
Sends an account number that violates the 3-20 alphanumeric rule. Expected result: 400 Bad Request and VALIDATION_ERROR.

response.name: 400 Invalid Account Number

item.name: Fund Transfers
item.description: Endpoints for transferring funds between persisted customer accounts. POST requests require Idempotency-Key and return the shared API response envelope.

request.description: Transfers funds from ACC001 to ACC002. Expected result: 201 Created.
Replays the same normalized transfer with the same Idempotency-Key. Expected result: 200 OK with the original transfer payload.

response.name: 200 Transfer Replay
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Funds transfer already processed for this idempotency key",
  "data": {
    "transferReference": "TRF-001",
    "sourceAccountNumber": "ACC001",
    "destinationAccountNumber": "ACC002",
    "amount": 1000.00,
    "sourceBalanceAfterTransfer": 4000.00,
    "destinationBalanceAfterTransfer": 3000.00,
    "status": "SUCCESS",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-04T02:39:00"
  },
  "errors": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-04T02:40:00+03:00",
  "path": "/api/v1/transfers",
  "errorCode": null
}

request.description: Reuses a transfer Idempotency-Key with a different payload. Expected result: 409 Conflict and IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT.

response.name: 409 Idempotency Conflict
response.body:
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Idempotency key has already been used with a different request payload",
  "errors": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-04T02:41:00+03:00",
  "path": "/api/v1/transfers",
  "errorCode": "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT",
  "correlationId": "corr-20260804-0007"
}

request.description: Omits the required Idempotency-Key header. Expected result: 400 Bad Request and MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.
Sends a transfer amount with more than 2 decimal places. Expected result: 400 Bad Request and VALIDATION_ERROR.

response.name: 400 Transfer Validation Error

request.description: Attempts to create a new transfer using an existing business transfer reference. Expected result: 409 Conflict and DUPLICATE_TRANSFER_REFERENCE.
Attempts a transfer that exceeds the source balance. Expected result: 422 Unprocessable Entity and INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.

response.name: 422 Insufficient Funds
response.body:
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Insufficient funds in source account",
  "errors": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-04T02:45:00+03:00",
  "path": "/api/v1/transfers",
  "errorCode": "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS",
  "correlationId": "corr-20260804-0011"
}

request.description: Attempts to transfer from an account that does not exist. Expected result: 404 Not Found and ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.
